mapper.insert: insert into lab_software(lab_id, software_name, software_version, install_path, license_info, install_time, remark) values( coalesce( nullif(#{labId}, 0), (select l.id from lab l where l.lab_name = #{lab} or concat(l.lab_code, ' ', l.lab_name) = #{lab} limit 1), 1 ), #{softwareName}, #{softwareVersion}, #{installPath}, #{licenseInfo}, #{installTime}, #{remark} )
mapper.select: select ls.id, ls.lab_id as labId, case when l.lab_name like concat(l.lab_code, ' %') then l.lab_name else concat(l.lab_code, ' ', l.lab_name) end as lab, l.lab_name as labName, ls.software_name as softwareName, ls.software_name as name, ls.software_version as softwareVersion, ls.software_version as version, coalesce(nullif(ls.remark, ''), '开发工具') as type, ls.install_path as installPath, ls.license_info as licenseInfo, ls.license_info as license, ls.install_time as installTime, case when ls.install_time is null then '待安装' else '已安装' end as status, case when ls.install_time is null then 'warning' else 'success' end as tagType, ls.remark from lab_software ls left join lab l on l.id = ls.lab_id order by ls.id
mapper.update: update lab_software set lab_id = coalesce( nullif(#{labId}, 0), (select l.id from lab l where l.lab_name = #{lab} or concat(l.lab_code, ' ', l.lab_name) = #{lab} limit 1), lab_id ), software_name = #{softwareName}, software_version = #{softwareVersion}, install_path = #{installPath}, license_info = #{licenseInfo}, install_time = coalesce(#{installTime}, install_time), remark = #{remark} where id = #{id}
